text:
marco: Quick sync: we've got recurring confusion where customers treat 429 as "always retry". we need a clear contract so SDKs and console can present the right action.

elaine: Agreed. We should avoid inventing a new status code. Header-based classification is safer and non-breaking for clients that ignore headers.

sam: Proposal: add `X-RW-Err-Category` and `X-RW-Err-Action`. Category ∈ {throttle, quota, billing, degraded, internal}. Action ∈ {retry, backoff, contact_support, fallback}.

rahul: Also add `X-RW-Err-Doc` pointing to the canonical doc fragment (short id) so support can link to exact wording. example: `X-RW-Err-Doc: ERR-429-QUOTA-V1`.

elaine: Console idea: on request inspector, show a small tag with category + tooltip with suggested client action (e.g., "retry with exponential backoff", "open billing portal"). That will reduce ticket churn.

marco: Telemetry: emit `error_classification` events with labels `route`, `category`, `action`, and `client_version` if provided. That will let us spot routes that mis-classify frequently.

sam: Rollout plan:
- week 1: emit telemetry only + console tags based on inferred heuristics (no header)
- week 2: deploy header in canary (10%) with no semantic change; SDKs read but ignore by default
- week 3: turn on console deprecation banner when >5% of traffic reports new classification

elaine: Compatibility note: some proxies drop unknown headers. add a minimal `error_meta` JSON field in the body for non-200 error responses to ensure visibility (body fallback). Keep <400 bytes.

rahul: Devex request: SDKs should expose `onClassifiedError(e, meta)` callback and a helper `shouldRetry(error)` that maps action -> boolean. We'll add docs and examples.

devex-bot: ticket #812 created: "error-classification headers + console inspector tag" assigned to devex + eng-platform.

marco: Action items: sam to write helm chart change for header emission, elaine to mock console inspector UI, rahul to add SDK hooks. We'll reconvene after canary metrics. :thumbsup:
